narrative_purpose: Teaches the forest's four stacked layers and the steep vertical light gradient at a glance: emergent crowns in full sun, a dense canopy roof, a shaded understory, and a dim floor living on as little as 1-2% of the light — with fauna sorted by height.
subject: A tall vertical cross-section of a Pandoran forest divided into four clearly separated horizontal bands stacked top to bottom: at the very top, a few isolated giant tree crowns standing alone in bright light with small winged creatures around them; below, a dense continuous roof of interlocking foliage; below that, a dim shaded zone of slender trunks and broad drooping leaves; at the bottom, a dark, faintly glowing forest floor with a large six-legged grazing animal. Along the right edge runs a narrow vertical strip that fades from bright pale at the top to near-black at the bottom, showing how light dwindles with depth.
scene: A diagrammatic vertical slice through a whole forest from crown to floor, the four layers visually distinct in brightness and density.
camera: A flat, side-on cross-sectional view, the full height of the forest in frame.
light: A continuous top-to-bottom gradient: brilliant at the emergent crowns, dimming through each layer to a deep, faintly bioluminescent floor; the right-edge strip reads as a pure light scale.
palette: Pale luminous light at top, cooling through Pandora cyan and living teal in the mid layers to void-indigo and faint glow at the floor.
style: Painterly speculative-biology naturalist plate with strong diagrammatic clarity, hand-painted texture.
detail_level: Crisp and legible on each of the four bands and the edge light-strip; soft atmospheric transitions between bands.
composition: Four stacked horizontal bands of roughly equal height, the light-gradient strip down the right margin, generous dark space at each band's side for callout labels.
consistency_notes: Pandoran forest rendered in the book's cool palette; the four-layer separation and the dimming light gradient must read instantly; leave dark margins for labels.
negative_prompt: no text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no diagram labels, no arrows, no photographic or 3D-render look, no lens flares, no neon UI glow, no cartoon or anime style
